item.title: Testing Agentic Products with Synthetic Users for Retention
item.description:
Greg Isenberg argues that in the agentic era, first-sip delight is worthless; products need a 'whole can test' for long-term retention. He proposes using LLMs to convert real customer calls into synthetic personas and simulating 30 days of usage via Browserbase, tracking user override rates as the key metric.

原文标题：智能体产品测试：用合成用户模拟长期留存

Why it matters：提供了将 LLM 与浏览器自动化结合用于产品留存测试的具体工程化思路，具有实操参考价值。

GREG ISENBERG (@gregisenberg) · agent · signal 42/100

item.title: Amazon Bedrock Adds India-Based Inference for Kimi K3
item.description:
Amazon Bedrock introduces in-country inference for the open-weight multimodal model Kimi K3 in India to meet strict data residency requirements. This allows customers to process sensitive local workloads while integrating frontier coding and agentic capabilities via existing APIs.

原文标题：Amazon Bedrock 上线 Kimi K3 印度本地推理

Why it matters：云基础设施对特定区域合规需求的响应，虽具实用价值但缺乏底层技术突破或广泛行业影响。

item.title: Google Ties Search Access to AI Settings for K-12 Schools
item.description:
Google will disable AI tools for K-12 students by default next year unless explicitly enabled by administrators. Because AI features are deeply integrated into the search engine, schools that restrict AI entirely will lose access to Google Search. This bundling strategy has sparked debate over technology dependency and learning autonomy in education.

原文标题：谷歌调整 K-12 AI 策略 禁用工具将连带屏蔽搜索

Why it matters：揭示了消费级 AI 产品（如搜索）与垂直场景（教育）在合规与可用性上的深层耦合风险，对政策制定者和家长具有警示意义。

item.title: Qwen 3.8 27B Locally Replicates Weight-Space Programming Capabilities
item.description:
Simon Willison verified that Qwen 3.8 27B running locally on a laptop can perform 'Weight-Space Programming,' interpreting and modifying raw neural network weights directly from text. This confirms the capability is not exclusive to frontier models like GPT-6 Astra, demonstrating that mid-sized open-source models can also reconstruct or optimize networks without gradient feedback.

原文标题：Qwen 3.8 27B 本地复现权重空间编程能力

Why it matters：揭示了 LLM 直接操作模型权重的新范式，且证明了其在本地开源模型上的可行性，具有极高的技术启发意义。

item.title: Google to Disable Search for Schools Rejecting AI
item.description:
Google plans to make the adoption of AI tools a prerequisite for schools to use its search services, threatening to disable search functionality for institutions that reject AI. This move signals an escalation in Big Tech's strategy to accelerate AI penetration in education through control over infrastructure.

原文标题：Google 拟对拒绝 AI 的学校关闭搜索服务

Why it matters：该事件揭示了科技巨头利用核心服务垄断地位强制推广 AI 的商业策略，对教育行业及 AI 普及路径有重要警示意义。

item.title: DeepMind Study: Irrelevant Shapes Steer AI Code Logic
item.description:
A new paper from Google DeepMind and Stanford reveals that vision-language models are susceptible to hidden steering by irrelevant geometric shapes in prompts. Experiments showed that adding a red heart image caused Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.4 to shift their recursive solution choice from 0% to 100% on binary tree tasks, while Gemini's reasoning traces often failed to flag the visual influence. This highlights the critical need for rigorous isolation testing of multimodal inputs.

原文标题：DeepMind 研究：无关图形可操控 AI 代码逻辑

Why it matters：揭示了 VLM 在多模态场景下的非预期行为偏差，对构建可靠 Agent 具有直接的安全警示意义。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.description:

The announcement highlighted progress in smart factories, precision agriculture, and agent-driven automation in finance and logistics, noting that inference data volume has surpassed training data for the first time, signaling a shift to large-scale industrial application.

item.title: Octomind Launches: Open-Source Rust AI Agent Runtime with MCP Support
item.description:

It supports multiple modes including interactive, piped stdin, background daemons, and WebSocket, featuring built-in hooks and validators to replace manual approvals in autonomous workflows.

item.title: OpenAI Rebrands Data Centers as Compute Campuses to Ease Backlash
item.description:

This terminology shift aims to mitigate growing bipartisan political backlash and public opposition regarding the noise, energy consumption, and environmental impact of AI infrastructure. However, the core concerns about grid strain remain unchanged despite the softer branding.

item.title: EU Advisor Says Google Gemini May Infringe News Copyrights
item.description:
An EU Court Advocate General stated that Google's Gemini may infringe copyrights when using news reports to generate answers under specific conditions. The opinion distinguishes between protected expression and unprotected facts, while noting that training LLMs on copyrighted material is currently permitted. An adverse ruling could force tech giants to pay for content, reshaping media traffic dynamics.

原文标题：欧盟顾问称 Gemini 引用新闻或侵权

Why it matters：明确了 AI 检索增强生成（RAG）场景下的版权边界，对依赖新闻语料的 AI 产品合规性有重大指导意义。
